title: The Elements Worn; the Three Rocks; Love and Hatred
description: What stands and what undoes itself. T62 — the Divine Human clothed in the elements stood against the self, with the lions-garment of strong loves swallowed and become a hidden river of judgment burning within those who consumed it. T63 — the three foundations of glory the Lord has set in the natural mind: the Pillar of Glory standing through the whole circuit, the Land of Light pressed down upon the land of darkness, the great Thought of Jesus the Radiance giving the understanding its light. T64 — what love and hatred are at their cosmic origin: love is the bond of the Greatness, the principle by which the Lord and all that is his are kept together as one body; hatred is selfhood's first death, the gushing-up of self-love that destroys even what it itself produces.
